mapLocation.label: Talk to Captain Lawgof, south of the Coal Trucks, north-west of the Fishing Guild.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Drogo's Mining Emporium in Dwarven Mines for 1 gp.

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to Captain Lawgof by the Coal truck mining site west of Seers' Village. Dialogue: "Yes."

route.title: Repair and retrieval
steps: Pick up the hammer in the house to the east if you do not have one.
Fix the six bent railings of the west and south sides of the fence.
Go to the tower south of the gate.
Climb up two ladders and take the Dwarf remains.
Run south (or teleport to the Fishing Guild) and enter the cave at the south-east corner of the Fishing Guild.
In the cave, go as far north-west as possible. In the north-westernmost room, search the northernmost crate by the east wall to find Lollk. You don't need to finish the conversation.
Talk to Captain Lawgof. Dialogue: "Okay, I'll see what I can do."
Use the toolkit you got from Captain Lawgof on the broken multicannon next to him. (In this order:)
Talk to Captain Lawgof. Dialogue: "Okay then, just for you!"

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Go to the Dwarven Black Guard camp north-east of Falador / south of Ice Mountain / west of Barbarian village.
In the outpost, talk to Nulodion. He is in the house on the west side of the mining camp.
Return to Captain Lawgof, bring Nulodion's notes and your cannonball mould with you.
